integrity: The universal estimate follows from one normalization, the definition of the James constant, norm convexity, and an exact square identity. The hexagonal equality example is independently established by a complete four-edge dihedral reduction and an explicit unrestricted Takahashi witness. The bundled checker supplies exact rational reproducibility checks but is not used as a substitute for the continuum proof. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives a sharp universal upper envelope in terms of the James constant and proves equality on the affine-regular hexagonal plane. It does not classify all equality spaces or determine whether every admissible James value is realized on the envelope.
title: Sharp James envelope for the Takahashi minimum von Neumann--Jordan constant
